title: UI transport validation, live HTTP and fixture transports

claims.text: validateJson rejects non-finite numbers, unpaired surrogates, non-plain objects, cycles, depth beyond 128, and any forbidden key, raising TransportError invalid_response.
checkCall refuses fixture mutations (fixture_readonly), mutations on read tools and reads on protected tools (bad_args), and memory_put with the operator actor or level-1 unit (forbidden_level).

createHttpTransport enforces a positive integer timeout, sends requests with an abort controller over fetch, and decodes the shared {untrusted} reply envelope; createFixtureTransport validates the whole fixture up front and serves only recorded read results from clones.

decision.rule: Change here when UI transport payload validation, read/protected tool gating, or the live and fixture transports need to change.
decision.failure: A valid tool reply is rejected as invalid_response, a fixture accepts a mutation, or a level-1 memory_put slips through.

questions.q: Where does validateJson reject cycles, deep nesting, or forbidden keys in a transport payload?
Where should I change which tools count as reads versus protected mutations?
Where can I debug why a mutation fails with session_required over HTTP?
